The structure of Ca2W6O16 (CaWO8) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies W centers as octahedral, each with six O neighbors, while Ca centers show eight O neighbors. The O environments are more varied, with 11- or 12-neighbor geometries. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals edge-sharing between W octahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ca and W coordination polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
